svg.text: Five ways of wiring the lag encoder (the weather and datetime encoders and the mixer are the same in all five)
Expected embeddings: the weather and datetime encoders applied at the lag's own time. Every arm also has the D5 output offset.
S0: One encoder reads both lags
[day lag, week lag, 4 expected-weather embeddings] -> encoder -> 32 numbers -> mixer
S1: Shared encoder + learnt lag ID
[one lag, its 2 expected embeddings, ID(day|week)] -> same encoder, twice -> 2 x 32 -> mixer
S2: Shared encoder, no lag ID
[one lag, its 2 expected embeddings] -> same encoder, twice -> 2 x 32 -> mixer
[day lag, ...] -> encoder A; [week lag, ...] -> encoder B -> 2 x 32 -> mixer
S4: Shared encoder + fixed period code
[one lag, its 2 expected embeddings, code(1 day|7 days)] -> same encoder, twice -> 2 x 32 -> mixer
